No female artist did — the premise is incorrect. Bad Bunny (male) was Spotify's most-streamed artist globally for three consecutive years, 2020, 2021 and 2022 (and again in 2025); he is the only artist ever to top that list three years running.

Among women, the most-streamed female artist was Billie Eilish in 2020, then Taylor Swift in 2021 and 2022 (and every year through 2025). Taylor Swift was the global #1 most-streamed artist only in 2023.
